CustomField.label: Expected Value Comes From
CustomField.description: For a "Verify with a query" check, this says where the expected value comes from. No default. "Fixed value" - type it in "Expected Value (Fixed)". "Record formula" - enter it in "Expected Value (Formula)". "Comparison query" - the expected value comes from the "Comparison Query" result. Leave unset for "Compare two queries" (both sides are queries) and for the operators "Is empty" / "Is not empty".
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Where the expected value comes from (query checks). "Fixed value" -> "Expected Value (Fixed)". "Record formula" -> "Expected Value (Formula)". "Comparison query" -> "Comparison Query". Leave unset for Compare two queries and "Is empty"/"Is not empty".
